full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white street photograph shows a group of people running directly toward the camera along a city sidewalk. Two dark-clothed figures dominate the front. On the left, a young man leans forward with one arm pumping and the other carrying pale papers or fabric; his moving face is slightly blurred. At center right, a woman in a dark coat strides forward with a focused expression, her hair lifted by motion. A large pale bundle swings beside her. Behind them, another woman and several men run in a compressed line, their faces and clothing progressively less distinct. The crowd fills most of the width, leaving only narrow glimpses of the street edge and building walls. Tall urban facades rise on both sides and converge toward a bright opening in the distance. The wall on the right streaks diagonally from the camera movement, while the buildings on the left are washed into softer vertical bands. The lower foreground captures blurred legs, coats, and a strip of paving that seems to rush toward the viewer. Light is bright and overcast, creating a pale high background and bringing a few faces and bundles forward against deep black coats. The picture has coarse film grain, strong contrast, and pronounced motion blur, but enough sharpness remains in the central faces to register the shared forward movement. A thin dark border encloses the image inside the square crop. No readable signs or words are visible. The overall effect is urgent and candid, with the city's perspective and the group's bodies pressing toward the lens in one crowded instant.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白街头照片中，一群人沿城市人行道直接朝相机跑来。两名深色衣服人物占据前列。左边的年轻男子向前倾，一只手臂摆动，另一边带着浅色纸张或布料；运动使他的脸稍微模糊。中右，一名穿深色大衣的女子大步向前，神情专注，头发被动作掀起。一个浅色大包在她身侧甩动。后面另一名女子和几名男子在压缩的一列中奔跑，脸和衣服渐渐不那么清楚。人群几乎填满画面宽度，只留下街边与建筑墙面的狭窄空隙。高楼立面从两侧升起，向远处明亮开口汇聚。右边墙壁因相机运动斜向拉成条纹，左边建筑则化成较柔和的竖向带。下方前景记录模糊的腿、衣摆和一条似乎扑向观者的铺地。光线明亮而像阴天，使远处背景发白，也让几张脸和包裹从深黑大衣前显出。照片有粗胶片颗粒、强反差和明显运动模糊，但中央人物面部仍保有足够清晰度，使共同向前的动作可读。细黑边框将影像围在方形裁切内。没有可读标牌或文字。整体效果紧迫而如抓拍，城市透视和人群身体在拥挤的一瞬压向镜头。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast monochrome street photography compresses a moving group into a tight frontal frame. Strong depth lines from flanking vertical surfaces converge behind the figures, while pale distant light separates dark coats and swinging limbs. Motion blur streaks walls, legs, and peripheral faces, but selected central expressions remain sufficiently clear to anchor the moment. Coarse grain and a narrow dark border reinforce the physical print character. The tonal design favors near-black clothing, silvery faces, and a bright blown background rather than a full smooth grayscale. The image feels candid, urgent, and crowded, its energy coming from bodies advancing through urban perspective.
style_prompt_zh: 高反差单色街头摄影把运动中的人群压进紧凑正面画框。两侧竖向表面的强烈纵深线在人物后方汇合，远处浅色光把深色衣服和摆动四肢分开。运动模糊拉伸墙面、腿部和边缘人物的脸，但少数中央神情仍足够清楚，固定住这一瞬。粗颗粒与窄深色边框加强实体相纸感。明暗设计偏重近黑衣料、银灰面部和亮得近乎失去细节的背景，而非完整平滑灰阶。影像如抓拍般拥挤紧迫，其能量来自身体沿城市透视向前推进。
theme_en: A crowd running toward the camera on a city sidewalk
theme_zh: 一群人沿城市人行道朝相机奔跑
name: Garry Winogrand
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
